title: Join Order and Join Performance — practice
prompt: A service is experiencing growth and must meet reliability goals. You are working on “Join Order and Join Performance”. Which practice is the strongest next step?
objective: Apply join order and join performance in a controlled MySQL workflow.

options: Join two synthetic related tables, count the result rows, and explain what happens when one side has no match.
Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.

expected_output: Join two synthetic related tables, count the result rows, and explain what happens when one side has no match.

hints: Start with the smallest repeatable example or inspection step.
